place: Choeng Mon, Koh Samui, Surat Thani, Thailand
title: New Three-Bedroom Garden Pool Villa with Covered Parking near Choeng Mon Beach
blurb: A new single-level villa built around a private pool and a wide green lounge lawn, a short walk from Choeng Mon Beach — living room and three en-suite bedrooms around the perimeter, covered parking at the entrance and handmade Balinese furniture, on a 300 m² plot from ฿25M.
detail:
Just a short walk from Choeng Mon Beach, this new villa is arranged as a courtyard house: the private pool and a broad, green lounge area sit at the centre, and the rooms are ranged around the perimeter so that nearly every one looks in on the water and the garden. There is no stair to climb — the whole home lives on one level, with a sala and pool deck for meals outdoors.

The living, dining and kitchen area forms one open wing, and the three bedrooms each have their own bathroom, wardrobe, desk and double bed, giving every guest a private base. Covered parking at the entrance keeps the car in the shade and out of the way.

The interiors are modern and warm, furnished with pieces handmade by artisans from Bali. At 111 m² of living space on a 300 m² plot, with the garden and pool taking up most of the land, it offers the ease of a low-maintenance home and the feel of a resort. Available on a freehold or leasehold basis, and equally suited to owner-occupation or holiday rental.
